'''Pergus Frode''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] [[Technician/Legends|technician]] employed by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Frode served in the hangar of the [[Sith academy]] on [[Odacer-Faustin]] under the direction of [[Darth Scabrous]]. When a [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|virus]] infected the academy's student body and turned them into [[Zombie/Legends|flesh-eating monsters]], Frode escaped the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] alongside [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Hestizo Trace]].
